column1: # Which marks of the dated strip each caption brings on screen (build.py reads this file).
# Columns: chapter <TAB> role <TAB> row <TAB> saved id
#   role "new":   the mark appears for the first time in this chapter. Every one of the records must be "new" exactly once.
#   role "again": the mark was shown in an earlier chapter and is lit again here.
#   row: BH Beijing holds Nvidia back | BL Beijing lets Nvidia in | CN companies reach for Nvidia | CH companies turn to home-made chips
#   saved id: an id of figure/figure_data.txt, or, with "new", "*" = every mark of that row not named as new anywhere else,
#             "*solid" = the same, filled marks only, "*press" = the same, open marks only; with "again", "*" = the whole row.
# The last chapter (the second part of the sentence that survives) lights every mark again; it needs no lines here.
# Round 4: twelve chapters, renamed for the core's 61 records. The record of Sept 16, 2025 on the RTX6000D now stands in the
# row "the companies reach for Nvidia", so chapter 2 brings it on (fix V6).
# 1. The declared line: the purchase rule for state bodies, the leader, the security ministry's warning, the state planner, the evaluation list
# 2. What the companies used and ordered: the whole row "the companies reach for Nvidia"
# 3. What Beijing did, on the record: the other filled marks of "Beijing holds Nvidia back" (the regulators' acts, three filings, a US official)
# 4. What Beijing did, as reported: the open marks of "Beijing holds Nvidia back"
# 5. The numbers: ordered; licensed by Washington (the report that about ten firms were cleared and nothing delivered); approved by Beijing; waiting
# 6. Limit 1, not one actor: the welcoming side of Beijing
# 7. Limit 2, warnings and guidance, not a published ban: the 2023 review conclusion on Micron (a published one), the state
#    broadcaster's account (a public warning), the security ministry's warning, and the 2024 report of "guidance"
# 8. Limit 3, approvals and arrivals: the rest of the row "Beijing lets Nvidia in"
#    Since core edit 7 (Nov 25, 2026) the "*" line below also brings on record 62 (the press report of Sept 27, 2026 on the RTX PRO 5500)
# 9. Limit 4, reasons of their own and American curbs: the whole row "the companies turn to home-made chips", and Nvidia's
#    report of Nov 19, 2025, which holds the sentence on US export controls
# 10. Limit 5, what Beijing meant: the antitrust case, the summons, and the customs report that names "a bargaining tactic"
# 11. The sentence, part 1 (the pressure and the warnings): the whole row "Beijing holds Nvidia back"
